chunks: Had We pleased, We could have shown them to you that you could know them by their marks, and recognise them from the way they twist their words. Yet God knows all your deeds.

key_terms.سِيمَاهُمْ: their marks (distinctive physical or spiritual signs)
key_terms.لَحْنِ الْقَوْلِ: twist of speech (distinctive tone or manner of speaking)

ai.seo_question: How did the Prophet Muhammad recognize the hypocrites among his companions?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual nature of recognizing the Munafiqun: while divine intervention could have made their hypocrisy physically manifest through 'Simah' (distinctive marks), the Prophet relied on 'Lahn al-Qawl' (the cadence or tone of speech) as a practical, observable sign. This distinction underscores the scholarly view that the Prophet's knowledge was both divinely aided and grounded in keen human observation, serving as a model for identifying hypocrisy through both outward behavior and inner intent.
